title: course.yaml (course format v1)
description: Manifest for one course. A folder with a valid course.yaml is a course.

format.description: Version of the course format this course follows.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never change it after publishing, even if the folder or title changes.

outcomes.description: What a learner can do after finishing the course.

prerequisites.description: What a learner needs before starting the course.

software.description: Git repositories this course pins as submodules. Must match .gitmodules.

path.description: Submodule path, relative to the course folder.

url.description: The repository the submodule is cloned from (the fork, for fork submodules).

upstream.description: The original project, for fork submodules.
